assets.prompt: Create a beautiful hand-painted fantasy atlas background, landscape 3:2, 1536x1024. Use-case illustration-story. An elegant book endpaper inspired by medieval Islamic cartographic manuscripts and Persian miniature landscape painting, aged warm ivory paper, restrained ink hachures, antique gold details, muted jade and slate blue sea, terracotta cities, intricate mountain ranges. NOT a modern political map, NOT a UI. No text, no labels, no typography, no symbols pretending to be writing. This will have real HTML/SVG labels overlaid. Geography must match this coordinate layout on a 1200 by 800 virtual canvas: western sea fills x0-190; a small island at (110,340). Main continent from x200 eastward, varied coastline reaching (250,480), then (450,580), then (600,555), then (760,655), then (1050,610), then east edge (1200,560). Sea occupies the southern quarter beneath this coastline. Snowy mountain kingdom centered (300,210); rugged ochre highlands (640,270); turquoise inland lake oasis (820,170); eastern desert canyon plateau (980,300). A rich coastal trading city with courtyards, domes, warehouses at (600,540); cultivated fields just inland near (720,610); another smaller coastal harbor at (930,575). Thin delicate caravan paths connect these regions. Upper edges remain land. Add delicate decorative geometric border, a small compass rose in lower left sea, miniature merchant sailing ships in southern sea. Keep labels locations uncluttered. High detail, coherent geography, flat top-down atlas with hand-drawn mountain perspective, luminous readable parchment, tasteful archival craftsmanship. No fire or combat.

Use-case illustration-story. Create a cinematic, photorealistic architectural fantasy environment for the Chronicle of Hanno Averroes. Landscape 3:2. The three supplied images are aesthetic references ONLY, not edit targets: preserve their luminous atmosphere, monumental scale, warm carved stone, impossible elegance, gardens and water, but invent a fresh coherent environment. Absolutely exclude social-media overlays, logos, UI, captions. Maximalist futuristic Mediterranean Middle Eastern fantasy. Scene: the House of Measures in Sidrat Al Muntaha, a spectacular open scholarly courtyard overlooking a vast still turquoise inland lake. Colossal ivory limestone arcades cut into pale cliffs, ornate brass astrolabes suspended in galleries, filigree latticework and intricate geometric stone ornament, subtle embedded luminous channels functioning as advanced instruments rather than neon sci-fi. A sacred-looking silver-leaf garden tree in a circular water court; rills connect pools. Layered terraces with olive trees, flowing plants, a single deep crimson woven carpet, carved wooden chairs, scholars and travelers in modest flowing neutral clothing tiny against architecture. Warm radiant sunlight, shafted volumetric light, atmospheric depth, bone white, antique gold, dusty teal, oxblood accents. Lived-in, contemplative, richly detailed, sophisticated cinematic matte painting realism. Beautiful visible material textures. Wide editorial composition with a strong central vista and quiet lower foreground. No text, no writing or calligraphy, no direct copy of reference buildings, no modern vehicles, no weapons, no cyberpunk, no minarets as arbitrary decoration.
